column1: # Every row is a case where this library and ICU disagree and the
# disagreement is expected. A new one fails the build; a row that stops
# reproducing fails too. An ICU version bump regenerates this file, and
# the diff is the point rather than a nuisance.

column7: note

The plural category asked for is absent at every width, so both sides fall back to count=other, and they take it from opposite ends. This library takes it from the narrowest width that has one, ICU from the widest. Akan is the case that decides it: week-narrow writes its own other with a space and the wide field writes one without, and ICU returns the wide value for a narrow request. Keeping the width that was asked for is the deliberate choice.
